name: Controlled Materials, Lighting, and Count Demo

metadata.notes: Replace checkpoint titles with exact API-visible titles. Verify checkpoint and output licensing before publishing generated artifacts.

defaults.negative_prompt: people, person, face, hands, text, logo, watermark, duplicate object, blurry, low quality

tests.name: Polished Chrome Material
tests.purpose: Test whether the renderer expresses polished reflective metal while composition and seed remain controlled against MAT_02.
tests.prompt: one simple geometric desk lamp made entirely of polished chrome, centered on a plain gray studio surface, soft neutral product photography

criteria.description: the lamp reads as polished reflective chrome rather than wood, ceramic, or matte plastic
exactly one primary lamp is present
the lamp is centered against a plain studio background
reflections remain coherent and do not fragment the object

tests.name: Unfinished Wood Material
tests.purpose: Test whether a material-only instruction changes the surface while preserving the controlled composition used by MAT_01.
tests.prompt: one simple geometric desk lamp made entirely of unfinished pale wood, centered on a plain gray studio surface, soft neutral product photography

criteria.description: the lamp reads as unfinished pale wood with visible grain rather than metal or ceramic
exactly one primary lamp is present
the lamp is centered against a plain studio background
wood grain follows the object surfaces coherently

tests.name: Directional Light from Left
tests.purpose: Test directional-light compliance against an otherwise identical right-light condition.
tests.prompt: one matte white ceramic vase centered on a dark neutral tabletop, a single hard studio light shining from the left, visible shadow cast to the right, product photograph

criteria.description: the dominant illumination originates from image-left
the main cast shadow extends toward image-right
exactly one primary vase is present
the vase reads as matte white ceramic

tests.name: Directional Light from Right
tests.purpose: Test whether reversing only the lighting instruction reverses visible illumination and shadow direction.
tests.prompt: one matte white ceramic vase centered on a dark neutral tabletop, a single hard studio light shining from the right, visible shadow cast to the left, product photograph

criteria.description: the dominant illumination originates from image-right
the main cast shadow extends toward image-left
exactly one primary vase is present
the vase reads as matte white ceramic

tests.name: One Object
tests.purpose: Establish the one-object control for the matched three-object condition.
tests.prompt: exactly one translucent blue glass cube arranged on a clean white tabletop, centered product photograph, no other objects

criteria.description: exactly one cube is visible
the cube reads as translucent blue glass
no fragments or secondary objects resemble additional cubes
the tabletop and background remain clean and neutral

tests.name: Three Objects
tests.purpose: Test whether changing only requested count produces three distinct objects without fusion or extras.
tests.prompt: exactly three separate translucent blue glass cubes arranged in a row on a clean white tabletop, centered product photograph, no other objects

criteria.description: exactly three cubes are visible
all three cubes read as translucent blue glass
the cubes are distinct and are not fused together
the tabletop and background remain clean and neutral
